senses.gloss:
विड् 1. विड् (= rt. विट्, q. v.), cl. 1. P. वे-
डति, वेडितुम्, to call out, cry out against,
curse, swear at, revile; to break (?).
2. विड्, ट्, f. a fragment, bit (?).

विड, अम्, n. a kind of factitious salt (procured
by boiling earth impregnated with saline particles);
a particular kind of fetid salt (used medicinally as a
tonic aperient, commonly called Vit-lavan or Bit-
noben, cf. विड्-लवण; it is black in colour and is
prepared by fusing fossil salt with a small portion of
Emblic Myrobalan, the product being muriate of soda
with small quantities of muriate of lime, sulphur,
and oxide of iron); a fragment, bit, portion (?).
—विड-गन्ध, अम्, n. the medicinal salt described
above.

विडङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, clever, able, skilful, con-
versant; (अस्, अम्), m. n. Erycibe Paniculata, a
vegetable and medicinal substance (considered of
great efficacy as a vermifuge).

विडम्ब् वि-डम्ब्, cl. 10. P. -डम्बयति, -यि-
तुम्, to imitate, act like (= अनु-कृ), copy, emulate,
simulate (with acc., e. g. तडिद्-विलसितानि विडम्ब-
यन्ति, they imitate the flashes of lightning); to
give anything another form, transform, distort; to
impose upon, deceive, cheat; to ridicule, deride,
mock; to afflict.

वि-डम्ब, अस्, m. imitation; afflicting, distress-
ing, annoyance.

वि-डम्बन, अम्, आ, n. f. imitation, copying,
assuming a similar appearance or dress, disguise,
masquerade, transformation, imposture, (कु-विडम्-
बना, f. base imposture); deceiving, deception,
fraud, breach of faith; disappointing, frustrating;
afflicting, distressing, vexation, mortification, pain,
distress; ridiculing, ridiculousness, ludicrousness.

वि-डम्बनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be imitated, to be
assumed as a disguise; to be distressed or annoyed.

विडम्बिन्, ई, इनी, इ, imitating, resembling; causing
deception or error.
विडारक विडारक, अस्, m. = विडालक, a cat.

विडाल विडाल, अस्, m. (also written बिडाल,
in Uṇādi-s. I. 117. said to be fr. rt. विड्, ‘to cry out;’
according to others perhaps fr. विश् + आल, ‘having
habitation with man’), a cat; the eye-ball; (ई), f. a
female cat; N. of a plant (= विदारी, q. v.).
—विडाल-
पद, अस्, m. a measure of weight (the same as the
Karṣa or weight of sixteen Māṣas).
—विडाल-प-
दक, अम्, n. the measure of a Karṣa.

विडालक, अस्, m. a cat; application of ointment
to the exterior of the eye (especially to the eyelids
when the lashes have fallen off or are ulcerated);
(अम्), n. yellow orpiment.
विडाली, f. See under विडाल above.

विडी वि-डी, cl. 1. 4. A. -डयते, -डीयते,
-डयितुम्, to fly asunder, fly apart, fly separately,
fly on one side or obliquely.

वि-डीन, अम्, n. the act of flying apart or ob-
liquely, one of the different modes of flight attributed
to birds; [cf. अ-विडीन; other modes of flight are
अव-डीन, उड्डीन, नि-डीन, प्र-डीन, परि-डीन,
सण्-डीन, डीन-डीनक, q. q. v. v.]
वि-डीनक, अम्, n. flying apart.

विडुल विडुल, अस्, m. a sort of cane, Cala-
mus Rotang.

विडूरज विडूर-ज, अम्, n. lapis lazuli,
(for विदूर-ज, q. v.)

विडोजस् विड्-ओजस् or विड्-औजस्, आस्, m. (said
to be fr. विड् or 2. विश् + ओजस्), N. of Indra.

विड्गन्ध विड्-गन्ध, विड्-ग्रह, &c. See
under 3. विष्.

वीडु वीडु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. strong, firm, &c.,
see वीऌउ.
—वीडु-जम्भ, &c., see वीऌउ-जम्भ.
—वीड्व्-अङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having strong limbs,
firm in body.
वीडय = वीऌअय, q. v.
वि-डम्ब्य, अम्, n. an object of derision.
